limits: Only original TRAIN pool is repeatedly partitioned. Old800 VAL, test and final are not inputs.
All methods share one frozen ImageNet backbone and cached features; no classifier or encoder retraining occurred.
Projection seeds and overlapping partition repeats are not independent training repetitions; no independent-seed confidence interval or promotion is inferred.
Outer-fold predictions are concatenated in original pool order before fixed69 MacroF1; fold MacroF1 is never averaged.
Temperature and alpha share inner TRAIN OOF fitting labels; outer score labels never enter the cell fit.
These are common-feature arithmetic covariance prototype controls, not old end-to-end E0/S0 retraining or official MPN-COV reproduction.
